name: Confidence + logit-norm + margin
tagline: Cosine-decayed entropy bonus, fixed L2 on logits, and a hinge that penalizes correct-class logits above 10.

key_hyperparams.name: schedule
key_hyperparams.role: annealed weight on conf and margin terms

diff_from_baseline: Beyond the confidence-penalty baseline, adds an unscheduled L2 logit penalty and a cosine-scheduled hinge that caps the correct-class logit at 10 to discourage logit explosion.

name: Conv-weight smoothness penalty
tagline: Tiny L2 penalty on horizontal/vertical first differences of every conv kernel, ramped up over the first 10 epochs.
init_recovers: No regularization for the first 10 epochs and at very small λ_base.
diff_from_baseline: A 1e-6-scale conv-kernel total-variation penalty (mean squared first differences along H and W of W) — replaces the entropy/orthogonality/dropblock baselines with a weight-smoothness prior.

name: Logit-L2 + depth-scaled hyperspherical + manifold mixup
tagline: Sums logit L2, a depth-weighted off-diagonal cosine penalty on conv filters, and a temperature-2 mixup distillation against the model's own predictions.

key_hyperparams.name: λ_ortho
key_hyperparams.role: weight on depth-scaled cosine off-diagonal penalty

key_hyperparams.name: depth_scale
key_hyperparams.role: linear depth scaling for conv layer ℓ

diff_from_baseline: Combines three distinct regularizers — logit-spectral decoupling, an orthogonal-reg variant that uses cosine similarity (after row-normalize) and a 1+ℓ/(L−1) depth scaling, and a self-distilled mixup KL term using T²-scaled soft labels at temperature 2.

key_hyperparams.name: λ_head
key_hyperparams.role: weight on normalized linear head Gram off-diagonal

diff_from_baseline: Code as displayed has a NameError on the return line (`out_reg` is never defined; the rival-smoothing computation produces `gate`, `rival_entropy`, `head_reg` but no `out_reg`) — the displayed final file errors out and the leaderboard score is from an earlier successful test. Intended design: replaces the global confidence-penalty baseline with a per-sample gated rival-distribution entropy (only when p_target exceeds a class-count-aware threshold), and adds a normalized-row Gram off-diagonal penalty on every nn.Linear instead of conv-only orthogonal reg.

name: Entropy + logit-variance + filter decorrelation
tagline: Maximizes entropy, hinges logit variance below 0.1·C, and averages off-diagonal squared cosine across all conv filters; ramps over the first 15% of training.
formula: $$\mathcal R = s(t)\!\left[0.12\,(\log C - H(p)) + 0.08\,(\mathrm{Var}_k z_k - 0.1\,C)_+ + 0.04\,\overline{\sum_{i\ne j}(\hat W_i\!\cdot\!\hat W_j)^2}\right],\quad s(t) = \min(t/0.15T, 1)$$

key_hyperparams.name: λ_conf
key_hyperparams.role: weight on (log C − H(p)) entropy gap

key_hyperparams.name: warmup
key_hyperparams.role: linear ramp for the entire term

key_hyperparams.name: min out_channels
key_hyperparams.role: skips conv layers below this width

diff_from_baseline: A summed three-term loss that fuses (i) the confidence-penalty baseline using (log C − H(p)) as a positive form, (ii) a relu hinge on logit variance with a 0.1·C target, and (iii) a row-normalized cosine off-diagonal penalty on conv weights (similar to but normalized differently from the orthogonal_reg baseline).
